'''Yawse Felsiy''' was a collector who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Felsiy inhabited the [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]], in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]].<ref name="SWG:DD" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Yawse Felsiy told a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to find [[dust durni]]s scattered throughout the [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. When the spacer accomplished this task, Felsiy awarded the individual with a [[Feather Duster|feather duster]] and advised to explore the galaxy for items to collect.<ref name="SWG:DD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Yawse Felsiy]]
Yawse Felsiy was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Yawse Felsiy was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 8 Notes for Jan 15 2008|Chapter 8]]" on [[January 15]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67563&month=012008|text=Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis}}</ref>

Felsiy's appearance was randomized after each server reset. Appearances Felsiy could appear as included, but were not necessarily limited to, [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], male [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], female [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], and female [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]].<ref name="SWG:DD" />
